name: AN Aur
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 10.29 days; its mean radius is 93.6 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AN Aur: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 93.6 +/- 8.1 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 14, Name='AN Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AN Aur: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 5301.6 +/- 463.4 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.6 +/- 0.057 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 10.3 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 93.6 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 5,302 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, AN Aur: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 201574982848108416 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none

gravityRange.source: Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra)
